title: List wire vertex coordinates of a named net
summary: Compiles the focused project, resolves each netlist line of a named net to its schematic wire and lists the wire's vertices in millimetres.
phrasings: get the coordinates of wires on a net
find schematic wires belonging to a net
go from a compiled net to the wire objects

commands.name: GetWireVertices
commands.description: List the vertices of the wires of a net
commands.params: Net=<name> (without it: list the nets that have lines)|Out=<file or folder> (optional)|Open=true (optional)|Base=1 (default) or 0 (vertex index base)
